user.title: Connect to YNAB
user.description:
Enter your YNAB access token to connect your budget.

🔹 **How to Get Your Access Token:**
Go to {developer_url} and generate a new API key.

⚠️ **Important Disclaimer:**
This integration is **not officially supported** by You Need A Budget (YNAB). Any issues or errors caused by this integration **are not covered by YNAB's official support channels**.

By proceeding, you acknowledge and agree to the following:
- YNAB does not provide support for this integration.
- Any issues must be resolved through community support (GitHub Issues: {github_url}, Home Assistant forums).
- You take full responsibility for API usage and compliance with **YNAB's API Terms of Use**.

📜 **Review YNAB's API Terms of Use:**
➡️ YNAB API Terms: {api_terms_url}

✅ **Check the box below to accept the terms and continue.**

init.title: YNAB Integration Options
init.description: Configure accounts, categories, and settings for your YNAB integration.

data_description.Users Allowed to Move Money: Home Assistant users who can move money with the YNAB services. Leave empty to block everyone.

get_category_history.name: Get category history
get_category_history.description: Return the recorded changes to a category's balance, newest first, with the reason for each where known.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category sensor to read the history of.

move_category_money.name: Move category money
move_category_money.description: Reassign money between two YNAB categories for the current month, like moving money in the YNAB app. Only users allowed in the integration options can call it.

from_category.name: From category
from_category.description: Category sensor to take money from. Leave empty to use Ready to Assign.

to_category.name: To category
to_category.description: Category sensor to give money to. Leave empty to use Ready to Assign.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: How much to move, in the budget's currency.

allow_overdraw.name: Allow overdraw
allow_overdraw.description: Allow moving more than the source has available.

transfer_account_money.name: Transfer account money
transfer_account_money.description: Create a YNAB transfer between two accounts. Only users allowed in the integration options can call it.

from_account.name: From account
from_account.description: Account sensor to transfer money out of.

to_account.name: To account
to_account.description: Account sensor to transfer money into.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: How much to transfer, in the budget's currency.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category sensor for the on-budget side. Required when one account is a tracking account.

memo.name: Memo
memo.description: Memo for the transaction. Defaults to who moved it.

allow_overdraw.name: Allow overdraw
allow_overdraw.description: Allow transferring more than the source account holds.
